title: RL Can Only Reinforce What It Sees Succeed
abstract: arXiv:2611.26084v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When a familiar rule stops working, an agent has to weigh what pre-training taught it against what it now observes. We ask how outcome-reward reinforcement learning (RL) changes this balance, in a puzzle world where both sides are known: small language models trained from scratch on games played by a Bayesian player, so that the prior and the right answer are exact. Base models hedge as their corpus did, and RL turns that hedging into decisions, in whichever direction the reward favours. But RL can only reinforce what it sees succeed. When the right action is rare, each run either learns it everywhere or not at all, and which runs take off is predicted before training by one count: the expected number of groups of attempts in which the action wins. About 35 such groups give even odds. The count holds for new and repeated problems and for groups of 4 to 256 attempts, and across learning rates, optimizers, GRPO variants and model sizes f

translated_title: 强化学习只能强化它所见到的成功
translated_abstract: 当一个熟悉的规则失效时，智能体必须权衡预训练教给它的内容与它当前观察到的内容。我们研究结果奖励强化学习（RL）如何改变这种平衡，并在一个两侧信息均已确定的谜题世界中进行验证：小语言模型在由贝叶斯玩家玩出的游戏数据上从头训练，因此先验和正确答案都是精确已知的。基础模型像其语料库那样进行对冲，而RL会将这种对冲转化为决策，方向取决于奖励偏向哪一方。但RL只能强化它所见到的成功。当正确动作很罕见时，每次训练要么在所有地方都学会它，要么完全学不会；而哪些训练能够成功，可以在训练开始前用一个计数来预测：该动作获胜的尝试组的期望数量。大约35个这样的组对应五成胜率。该计数对新问题和重复问题均成立，对4到256次尝试的组均成立，并且在不同学习率、优化器、GRPO变体和模型规模下均保持成立。
tldr: 在先验与正确答案均已精确已知的谜题环境中，该研究发现结果奖励强化学习只能强化训练中实际观察到成功的动作——当正确动作罕见时，训练能否“起飞”可由训练前即可计算的一个统计量（动作获胜的尝试组期望数量，约35组对应五成概率）准确预测，且该规律跨多种实验设置普遍成立。
en_tdlr: Using a controlled puzzle world where both the prior and the correct answer are exact, this paper shows that outcome-reward RL can only reinforce actions it observes succeed, and whether training takes off when the correct action is rare is predicted before training by a single count—the expected number of attempt groups in which the action wins—with about 35 such groups giving even odds.
